classifiedFinding.title: pendingPhUSD() and pendingStable() view-helpers underflow for users with stale debt after pauseWithdraw

classification.assetImpact: No fund risk. Off-chain dashboards, indexers, and contracts calling these view functions revert.
attackPath: 1. Same pre-state as DEDUP-002 (user post-pauseWithdraw with stale debt).
2. Front-end / integrator calls pendingPhUSD(user) or pendingStable(user).
3. Call reverts Panic 0x11 — UI cannot display position info.
classification.assumptions: Same as DEDUP-002 (pause cycle + partial pauseWithdraw)
classification.externalRequirements: Front-end or integrator calls the affected view

classifiedFinding.justification: C4 explicitly lists 'Unused view functions (QA at best)' as a known invalid category. Even when integrators do call the view, the impact is purely informational/UI — no fund loss, no on-chain DoS that isn't already captured by DEDUP-002. The remediation is a one-line clamp; bundle with DEDUP-002. Classified as Low/QA.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-medium; classifier downgrades to Low/QA per the C4 view-function rule. The mutating-path DoS is captured by the Medium DEDUP-002.
